cycles.title: The Older Inhabited World
cycles.eyebrow: Earlier powers, practiced institutions, and the generations before Nell.
cycles.description: The chosen older sequence contains territorial powers and long-lived local obligations, public offices, household economies and established teaching. Nemea's water protection, Hadrik's reservoir repair and the rooster's road service now share a proposed period of established settlements and regional military activity; their distinct capacities give no sequence of invention. Municipal assessment, field-care training and rural maintenance occupy another proposed overlapping period: Candlemere's intake already spans village rooms, barges, noble kitchens and mining camps, while Lanternscrape combines living favors with existing crafts and supplies. These settings establish no common polity or exact regional connections. Isolated practitioners and privately retained workings lead into an ordinary-looking modern reach. Nell and Bash's low-magic home is its final fixed landmark; Ravel keeps its unresolved place.
cycles.sequenceNote: This is a proposed temporal reconstruction of one world. Each independent story has a selected position; shared episodes stay together where continuity supports it. Positions are ordering slots, not measured orbital dates. Local years, flashbacks and unplaced destinations remain in the individual histories. Resemblance of subject, genre or appearance does not establish a shared era.

eras.title: When the Eagle Bowed
eras.description: The custodial queen's execution → Her conquest a century later and the shadow's release.
context: A century after a custodial queen's execution, three successor crowns still enforce different claims on the living talonmail. This is already a layered political landscape: old passages have fallen, warrants have diverged, and later towns occupy the threatened ground. Yavren's recovered previous life does not give her a hereditary right over those inhabitants. The older-cycle position is proposed; neither the century nor the eagle's distress signal identifies an original age of monarchy.

Yavren defeats all three kings with the living armor and accepts the valley's crown, completing her revenge against the successor houses. Releasing the armor's Eagle shadow to win the last battle leaves it hunting beyond her control. The shadow remains loose, and the damaged kingdom has not yet been rebuilt.
eras.sequenceNote: The first proposed event in this cycle, before The Gentlest Terror. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: Where the Eagle Lands
eras.description: Nine years after a chosen departure → A year raising two cities and choosing a shared home.
context: Yavren returns nine years after saving the eyries and valley, refusing the Eagle Queen's throne and revenge, and going east with her foster sister Pelka. She has already mastered the Eagle Shadow and has loved Irdas for six years. This bookend follows that departure history; the separately retained When the Eagle Bowed recounts a different conquest ending.

Across a spring-to-spring year, Yavren raises Esvay and Tolrath while residents rebuild their lives. The three kingdoms ratify a common assembly, free settlement and joint defense; rival garrisons withdraw and a royal relative loses a property claim. The union governs without giving Yavren a throne, and her shared home with Irdas permits further journeys.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed beside the related Yavren story in the older magic-active world. The supplied departure premise and local nine-year interval do not reconcile the retained conquest version or establish an absolute date; neighboring independent histories remain unordered.

eras.title: The Gentlest Terror
eras.description: An old alliance order and a recent royal death → The accession, flood rescue and resumed convocation.
context: Ersene already has an old alliance law, noble houses, quarry works, maintained watersheds and dragons with centuries of experience. Three weeks after King Ambric's death, a witnessed refusal and flood crisis test that existing order. The retained older position concerns this established territorial society, not the first appearance of dragons, monarchy or public service.

The king's three-week absence is distinct from the much older institutions and dragons' lives. No global founding date is established. Injury care and House Flint's ordinary judgment remain consequences beyond the witnessed crisis.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after When the Eagle Bowed and before Mother of Monsters. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: Mother of Monsters
eras.description: A maintained refuge in older works → An assault and a temporary escape.
context: An occupied refuge depends on older masonry, culverts, counterweights and planned winter stores. Its attackers have ranked command, powder charges, trained sappers and engineering standards. This proposed older placement therefore includes substantial technical institutions; it is not a primitive age inferred from the sanctuary's inhabitants. The building's age, the army's earlier campaigns and their relation to other states are unknown.

Halwen's painful warnings do not command the refugees or beasts. Independent route choices and physical engineering delay pursuit at the cost of stores, maintained mechanisms and the refuge itself. The host survives, repairs remain possible and Chask still faces an account of her charge.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Gentlest Terror and before The Name the Water Took. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: The Name the Water Took
eras.description: Three weeks of survey marks → One day's loss, recovery and escape.
context: Three weeks of an armed survey create a mapped approach to people Ioshka wants to protect. Trade in seed stocks, practical route knowledge and a captain's trained crew precede the pool encounter. The memory-stripping water supports a proposed active-magic placement, but neither an organized survey nor a jungle setting dates the expedition against another civilization. Its patron, larger purpose and Braska's change of motive remain unknown.

Recovered sensory fragments confirm separate actions without restoring their reasons. Ioshka retrieves the seeds and chooses the onward route; Braska's earlier coercion remains part of the history, and the pursuing survey has only been delayed.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after Mother of Monsters and before Friends of the Night. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: Friends of the Night
eras.description: Six years of changed dusk-keeping → Three siege nights and their aftermath.
context: Shalegate's siege follows an older keeper's defensive drives and six years of changed lighting, slaughter routes and tolerated nearness under Tavik. The fortified barley valley and invading host both have functioning supply and command systems. Their proposed older placement retains this local history; canon leaves the event's position before extinction or after reawakening unresolved. It has no established common war or creature system with the other frontier stories.

Withdrawal preserves the host and the fort without producing an alliance. Two soldiers are still absent at the last count, one beast is missing, dens have burned, and both defensive works and food supplies need attention.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Name the Water Took and before The Ninety-Year Barrier. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: The Ninety-Year Barrier
eras.description: Ninety years of casting → A later repair within one day.
context: The witch describes ninety years spent casting the barrier, not ninety years of completed service. Old villagers remember its final stakes from childhood. A grain mill, specialized craft orders and an existing escape provision belong to a settled community with accumulated knowledge. Its older-cycle position remains proposed; the construction span does not make this the first civic protection or date it against another village.

A basket worker's practiced hand finds the release the witch's first explanation missed. Their repair preserves escape from within while blocking the accidental outside sequence. The worker returns to ordinary obligations without an apprenticeship, debt or continuing service imposed.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after Friends of the Night and before One Night's Mercy. These are distinct local histories; the barrier's long casting does not establish an order against the neighboring siege or rescue.

eras.title: The Last Day of the Watch
eras.description: A centennial handover exposes thirteen years of concealment, followed by a pursuit through the ruined citadel and the retirement escort's arrival at dawn.
context: The horned elves choose one archer for each century of service at an unnamed ruined citadel. Phelnis arrives to replace Kostral, while Osmund has survived thirteen years inside its walls after an illicit excavation. These local spans establish neither the vanished civilization's age nor a date shared with another story.

Phelnis's attempt to summon her predecessor puts Osmund in immediate danger. Her later shot ends Kostral's pursuit, and she opens the gate before meeting his escort the next morning. The older-history placement is proposed; the story establishes no larger war, magical system, or outcome of the escort's judgment.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Ninety-Year Barrier and before What the Wind Wanted. These are independent local histories; this ordering slot is an editorial reconstruction, not a measured date or an established connection.

eras.title: What the Wind Wanted
eras.description: Universal comprehension leads Zerune from a coastal market to the courtship of two living winds.
context: Zerune gains comprehension of unfamiliar speech, writing and signing in an undated coastal society with markets, orchards and a pedestrian tunnel through a mountain spur. A living breeze asks her to carry it through the cold passage in her held breath. Its dependence on warmth and a coherent turn is a local capacity, not a property of all wind.

Beyond the tunnel, a basin current answers the breeze and the two begin moving and speaking together. Zerune witnesses their changing communication without discovering the origin of her gift or a general account of wind life. Neither their meeting nor the nearby drowned temples establish ties to another recorded place or event.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed in the older inhabited world before the extinction of old magic. This independent afternoon has no established order relative to neighboring stories; its selected slot is editorial reconstruction, not a measured Galactic Cycle date.

eras.title: The Ring Between Lives
eras.description: Three centuries with an unused ring → Six weeks of letters → A moonlit proposal and dawn marriage.
context: Rhazelle has outlived two marriages to earlier incarnations of the present saint. Sidonie arrives with her own memories, political authority, and romantic intentions. The queen recognizes a returning soul and hears the current narration, but cannot know forthcoming words or the saint's unspoken thoughts. These local faculties support a magic-active placement without dating the story against another civilization.

Six weeks of truce correspondence precede the wedding-dress arrival. A witnessed marriage compact settles competing claims to a border duchy; joint cessation orders leave before dawn, and the nearest fronts acknowledge them before the wedding. The queen's three-hundred-year ring history and earlier bereavements supply internal time, while the larger historical position remains editorial reconstruction.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed within the older magic-active world. This position establishes no shared kingdom, connection, or measured interval with neighboring stories.

eras.title: One Night's Mercy
eras.description: Earlier quarry work and the authorized nest raid → Dawn escape and the remaining trigger disabled.
context: An existing quarry, a forge levy, a dismissed engineer and a royal copper survey precede the rescue. Urrava's concealed authorization and Daziel's dangerous reuse of ordinary lifting equipment make this a local history of extraction and accountability. The older placement remains proposed; the quarry is not established as a frontier, and the dragon's bounded fire does not identify its underlying system or date the kingdom.

Imer built the inspection route when Daziel was a child. The occupied shelter was burned twelve days after her husband's death; the gap from that attack to this rescue is unspecified. Daziel has held the lever for six wet hours when they meet. The night ends with a limited escape and disarmed machinery, not recovered royal trust or a settled human-dragon peace.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Ninety-Year Barrier and before The Unfinished Sunset. No common dragon, polity, magical system or measured interval follows from those positions.

eras.title: The Unfinished Sunset
eras.description: A working solar harvest is trapped → Release after twenty outside years.
context: Aderi's collective solar harvest already uses trained keepers, mineral panes and copper rails before Arveth's flight from a grain-seizing authority. Her overload, opposed sword motion and cut release braid trap the village while she escapes. Its proposed older position describes one agricultural and political history; a solar apparatus supplies no lineage to the later Glass Sea network and its twenty-year catch is not a world-wide event.

The inhabitants retain remembered repetitions without bodily aging. Release requires prepared vanes, living keepers and an actual disarm, not a moral judgment by the apparatus. Night returns, but Arveth remains under watch and the village still needs work and decisions about what follows.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after One Night's Mercy and before The Lion's Last Constellation. These neighboring positions are a reconstruction, not an established succession or measured interval.

eras.title: The Cat Who Kept the Door
eras.description: A three-moon alignment awakens a buried artificial sovereign, followed by a confrontation and escape beneath the royal tombs.
context: Forty-one days into Isabet's reign, Murrant retrieves a scythe abandoned after his eighth death. His nine remembered lives span successive royal families, while Aphan's surviving images show much older civilizations occupying the same mountain landscape. These are local spans and layered civilizations, not world resets or a shared calendar.

Murrant's living magic confronts Aphan's manufactured body and surviving machinery. Isabet helps him escape the damaged chamber with his final life intact. This proposed position before the extinction of old magic establishes no connection to another kingdom, AI, magical system, or observed configuration of moons.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Unfinished Sunset and before the older regional histories grouped with The Lion's Last Constellation. The neighboring positions are editorial reconstruction; neither the alignment nor the earlier civilizations establish an exact date or a shared event.

eras.title: The Lion's Last Constellation
eras.description: Earlier training and the spring's summer failure → A shared account after one night's fight.
context: Nemea already has a council, training courses, terraces and water-carrier work when a summer spring failure makes one remaining channel critical. The council's witness rule governs credit for Myrine's seven-light deed, while the lion exploits the terrain and the pair's separation. Its proposed older period may overlap Hadrik's reservoir repair and the rooster's road protection. Established settlements, water works, practiced crafts and regional military activity coexist in this reconstruction; the stories establish no shared polity or succession between them.

Two previous disruptions of the water carriers precede the lion's early arrival on the witnessed night. The seven lights are spent within this one encounter. Kletho's interrupted count does not measure the final hold reliably; after the magic expires, Myrine continues by ordinary strength. The council's response to their account remains ahead.
eras.sequenceNote: Selected within one proposed older period for Nemea's water protection, Hadrik's reservoir repair and the rooster's road service. The three may overlap; their mutual order and regional connections remain unknown. The Unfinished Sunset and the municipal, college and village histories retain their selected positions on either side. This window is neither a measured duration nor a shared calendar.

eras.title: The Last Thing I Could Fix
eras.description: An established repair trade and a failed first gate attempt → A revised sign next morning and changed later work.
context: Traveling clients sustain Hadrik's established magical repair trade, while court expectations place dangerous work on Aven and neglected reservoir fittings still need maintenance. The old harness was intended to recruit willing protectors; a split assent rivet makes protective reflexes sufficient. Aven refuses both that failure risk and an automatic heroic obligation. Its proposed older period may overlap Nemea's water protection and the rooster's road service. An existing workshop and working reservoir supply this context; the harness does not mark a later stage of magic than Myrine's lights or an origin for the bird's armor.

The promise of a two-hour conventional repair is rejected in favor of a redesign. Its three hard uses are the padded test, Hadrik's catwalk rescue and the gate hold; light consent testing spends no further rivet. The harness is exhausted, both workers are injured, and Aven requests ordinary mail and a crew. Hadrik changes his sign the following morning and describes a continuing change in his trade.
eras.sequenceNote: Selected within one proposed older period for Nemea's water protection, Hadrik's reservoir repair and the rooster's road service. The three may overlap; their mutual order and regional connections remain unknown. The Unfinished Sunset and the municipal, college and village histories retain their selected positions on either side. This window is neither a measured duration nor a shared calendar.

eras.title: The First Call
eras.description: An armorer first meets the rooster → A shared retreat seven years later.
context: Seven years of repairs let an army armorer misread an independent road protector as her side's mascot. The final rescue exposes that mistake. Armor fitting and recruit training support the army, while contested roads carry soldiers and civilians. Its proposed older period may overlap Nemea's water protection and Hadrik's reservoir repair; no change of government or capability orders those histories. The bird's maker, training and original mission remain unknown, and its dawn-bound growth is one capacity, not an army-wide capability.
The seven-year repair history is explicit. It dates neither the armor's construction nor the beginning of the bird's independent mission.
eras.sequenceNote: Selected within one proposed older period for Nemea's water protection, Hadrik's reservoir repair and the rooster's road service. The three may overlap; their mutual order and regional connections remain unknown. The Unfinished Sunset and the municipal, college and village histories retain their selected positions on either side. This window is neither a measured duration nor a shared calendar.

eras.title: The Fourth House
eras.description: Ten years using a supplied faculty → A limited license at 11:23 and a still-unfinished cistern job.
context: The city already licenses working faculties through assessors, guilds and insurance. Ten years of Beral's supplied clay-softening end before Pelmara's different adult-developed capacity is tested and provisionally licensed. The next cistern job still needs drainage, correctly sized parts, rest and ordinary repair. Its proposed overlap with Lanternscrape and Candlemere describes compatible professional settings, not shared categories, regulators or the invention of a universal fourth source.

Withdrawal is recorded at 9:52 before the noon permit deadline. One stress redistribution locks Pelmara's hands and leaves stiffness; she refuses repetition. Cultivated is entered for this one observed faculty on a ten-day provisional license at 11:23. Recovery, site diagnosis, replacement work and later reassessment remain ahead.
eras.sequenceNote: Selected within the same proposed period as Candlemere's training and Lanternscrape's maintenance crisis, after The First Call and before The Shape of Mercy. The three may overlap; their mutual order, institutional links and calendar dates remain unknown.

eras.title: The Witchknight’s Measure
eras.description: A healer's first morning of a standard training course → A qualified road assignment and recovery after the capstone.
context: Candlemere recruits existing healers from villages, barges, noble kitchens and mines through service records, fees or sponsorship. A standard two-year course can be extended by repeated gates; Rhoswen's twenty-seven months prepare her for guarded field care and ordinary road duty. This varied intake supports the proposed overlap with rural maintenance and municipal craft. It does not establish a shared guild, curriculum, magical source or medical tradition with those places or Emet's shelter circuit.

The ordinary course is twenty-four months; Rhoswen's repeated gates add a quarter. Demech's earlier six years of survey work precede his field-healer training. The capstone requires six-breath transitions within twenty breaths of cover. His recovery includes six clinic days and three weeks of light duty; Rhoswen receives a road assignment and a refresher date twelve weeks ahead, not a completed first rotation.
eras.sequenceNote: Selected to overlap the municipal assessment and Lanternscrape's maintenance crisis. Its twenty-seven-month course is a local duration, not the width of this Galactic Cycle window or a date for the other institutions.

eras.title: The One Who Helped Everyone
eras.description: Years of useful favors and unfinished closures → Next morning's marked workings and shared repairs.
context: Lanternscrape has a mill, cistern, trained craftspeople and a road used by visiting specialists. Aumiri's modest sustained favors circulate through many open returns; the apparent vast reservoir is a measurement error. Replacement parts and ordinary repairs are already available. Its proposed overlap with a municipal assessment and Candlemere's training follows their compatible rural, urban and traveling support systems, without identifying one city, licensing law or profession.

A locating pulse triggers the current crisis; successive closures extend the initially short forecast. By sunset the cistern, mill and bridge remain linked through the same water system, requiring physical preparation before release. Next morning three bounded workings remain. The mill bearing had arrived four days earlier while a favor still supported its worn predecessor.
eras.sequenceNote: Selected to overlap the municipal assessment and Candlemere's training. Existing rural skills and supplies allow coexistence with those institutions; the village is not dated as their ancestor or consequence.

eras.title: The Shape of Mercy
eras.description: Adrian intervenes at nine → The succession crisis ten years later.
context: A landed household conceals Adrian's severance gift from him for ten years after his childhood intervention against his father. The succession crisis makes informed choice and ordinary witnessed records part of his stewardship. Tenants, damaged orchards and injured relatives remain after the magical coercion ends.
His family conceals his faculty during the interval. The present severance is recorded before the act and witnessed afterward; the record preserves evidence without restoring the missing memory.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after the overlapping municipal, training and village histories and before The Sister Behind Her Smile. This selected order does not identify their rulers, institutions or elapsed intervals.

eras.title: The Sister Behind Her Smile
eras.description: Six days of self-suppression → The seventh-dawn binding cadence is interrupted.
context: Palace seamstresses, paid gracework and acoustic craft support a wealthy household. After six days of self-suppression, Odrienne cuts her anchor as the musicians disrupt the seventh-dawn cadence that would bind it. That morning she orders a review of dismissals from the previous two years.
The letters follow before breakfast that morning. Their two-year interval looks backward over dismissals to be reviewed, not forward to a later reform.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Shape of Mercy and before A Note of Spite. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: A Note of Spite
eras.description: A friendship formed thirty years earlier → A birthday song after months of rehearsal.
context: Protective perfume, music and household work support a consumer enchantment economy. Clorinda has rehearsed for her birthday beyond a thirty-year friendship's familiar roles. A defense against hexes cannot make Lavinia listen; the friend must choose to leave the song to its singer.
The friendship supplies shared habits; months of preparation with a pianist give Clorinda an ambition beyond their old duet. Lavinia must decide how to respond during the performance.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Sister Behind Her Smile and before The Thousandth Fall. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: The Thousandth Fall
eras.description: One afternoon's interrupted self-mend → The thousandth fall and forty-seven survivors.
context: Midsky Cloister, ridge roads, grain traffic and a busy pilgrim crossing exist before Rasden's discovery. An interrupted self-mend lets completed living effort become his new bodily baseline; separate practice develops strength, speed and stamina. This individual history fits the selected older active world without dating the origin of healing, establishing a common school with other stories or promising the same results to everyone. The bridge's failure comes from spring melt in the gorge, independently of his training.

The first afternoon supplies twelve counted falls and the following season develops separate kinds of practice. The thousandth is an achievement count, not elapsed years; dawn was the plan that the earlier rescue overtook.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after A Note of Spite and before Kethra's qualification and later teaching. The latter stories share their own established sequence; their relationship to this fall remains reconstruction, not a measured interval.

eras.title: Kethra's qualification and later teaching
eras.description: Kethra qualifies, begins teaching, and later faces a different responsibility toward an apprentice.
context: Four years designing a voiced lattice precede Kethra's examination in an already established callwright college. A structural failure turns the trial into a rescue; her qualification and first safety briefing belong to this story. Lock continues the same archmage's practice later. The older-cycle position is proposed, while the college's wider institutional ancestry remains unknown.

Kethra already bears her new archmage seal when an apprentice's third morning of petitioning leads to an offered seven-day trial. Only its first day and night are witnessed. A failed lesson exposes how fear of losing housing can distort agreement, and Kethra separates board from work. The direct sequel has no measured interval or completed seven-day outcome.
eras.sequenceNote: The same Kethra and call-link practice establish the sequence. Voice already includes her first archmage briefing; Lock witnesses only the first day and night of a later offered seven-day trial. The intervening interval and wider era remain unmeasured.

eras.title: The Weight of Falling Up
eras.description: An established flight school and years of observation → One morning's qualified pass.
context: Nine Eaves already maintains practice brooms, inspected horse equipment, course lanes, standard diagrams and a rooftop-survey practicum. Juni's assessment tests a known three-breath stabilizer and repair judgment within that established profession. The school predates this assessment; its wider date and any historical descent into Lowen's city or Brightward College remain unknown.

The survey roster closes that day. Three breaths measures the one-use stabilizer, not the whole flight. Juni fails stationary control but passes the overall assessment with declared repair margins; no later survey assignment or wider adoption is shown.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after A Lock on the Inside and before Hello, Lover. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: Hello, Lover
eras.description: A breakup nine years earlier and a theft three days ago → The closed crossing, an hour of care and dawn at the shelter.
context: The House of Common Shelter sustains travelers through an existing twenty-year circuit with no posting beyond one season. That service commitment helps explain Emet's choice nine years earlier but never forbade his relationship. A stolen private hinge and added borrower loops now endanger both a full shelter and a working kiln court. Its separate road institution supports a comparison with Candlemere; no common route network, training order or material coordinate for the far side is established.

Twenty years describes the shelter circuit's required span, not a newly completed journey or the length of the breakup. The crisis occurs during one autumn evening. After the leaves are destroyed, Emet treats injuries for an hour and reports the concealed theft; restrictions on solo watch and route decisions remain in force at dawn.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Weight of Falling Up and before The Friends I Built. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: The Friends I Built
eras.description: A solo design accepted the previous week → The first morning of confirmed adult-arranged transport.
context: Cinder Annex is a local secondary school with workshops, equipment, entry rules and existing access failures. Irix's shaping current grows living embermoss collaborators whose choices improve the relay and emergency response. The incident changes one school's practices and the household's transport obligations. Its selected older position does not connect the school to Candlemere, a universal infernal education system, another constructed population or a known material-world location.

The collaboration requirement gives Irix three days before entries lock. The annual exhibition also lasts three days; that is not an additional waiting period. On exhibition morning the team adapts its cart in eleven minutes. Local reforms and the support agreement follow the emergency; the standing conveyance is shown working the next morning, without establishing lasting compliance everywhere.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after Hello, Lover and before Only Eighteen. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: Only Eighteen
eras.description: Twins arrive at six weeks → The twins leave at eighteen.
context: A professional caregiver with almost two centuries of experience raises her first human twins from six weeks to eighteen within working households, coach routes, wage labor, bakery training and theater. Those services continue as the twins choose their own work. The older placement is retained as one possible inhabited period; neither elf physiology nor the absence of a depicted spell supplies a date or population origin.

Almost two centuries of earlier care precede these eighteen human years; that career is not the age of this home or of the whole society. The twins' departure is witnessed, while a later performance visit remains a promise.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Friends I Built and before The Night Harvest. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: The Night Harvest

context: Three months of corpse processing support roofs, rope, fuel, clinic supplies and debt. A six-night investigation exposes the preserved nodes' directional effect; destroying the stock changes handling while ordinary salvage and unpaid obligations continue. Its category and position relative to either magical boundary remain unknown, so this older trade placement stays proposed.
Three months of local industry, followed by a six-night investigation. The fighters bring handling knowledge the local industry lacks; their origin and prior history remain unknown.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after Only Eighteen and before The Way Around. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: The Way Around
eras.description: An already ancient, repeatedly visited structure → The current expedition's dawn escape.
context: Paid relic hunters, expedition claims and multiple old scripts meet a dangerous surviving mechanism. Commercial exploration supplies its present-day context; the builders' civilization and the mechanism's category remain unknown.

The afternoon-to-dawn expedition is one short event inside several unmeasured histories. Construction, warnings and earlier visits are not assigned to neighboring stories or civilizations; the final emerging arrow leaves the mechanism's full closure uncertain.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Night Harvest and before Tea for the First Guest. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: Tea for the First Guest
eras.description: The tower's uncertain age and centuries without a guest → A second infusion beside the open road.
context: The wizard maintains a privately aligned tower beside a world of carriers, printers, bookbinders and paid lodging. He recalls imperial duties and freight relays, but the visitor cannot establish those powers' present reach or fate. The retained older placement concerns this functioning commercial setting and its isolated magical neighbor. The tower's age and centuries without a guest do not date a collapse outside it; other intruders have entered, and the present visitor gives only the local knowledge he has.

The wizard calculates 2,012 foundation years from the visitor's calendar, uncertain by four or five years, and says he is seven months older. His 387 guestless years do not exclude intruders. The roughly twenty minutes outside and the cart's ten-to-fifteen-minute approach are estimates; departure is not shown.
eras.sequenceNote: Proposed after The Way Around and before The Wrong Side of the Part. Explicit connections carry established or supplied order; other neighboring positions remain reconstruction. These slots are not measured Galactic Cycle coordinates.

eras.title: The Wrong Side of the Part

context: Proposed in the generations before Nell's low-magic home, where a privately kept implement can survive within ordinary business and family life. The wig's maker is unknown; the story establishes no family magical craft lineage. Its nonliving focus narrows Tilda's attention without replacing her judgment. This local survival does not prove that every earlier institution has vanished.

eras.title: The Trouble With Tuesdays
eras.description: The grandfather’s card-game contract → Rose inherits the watch.
context: The Fenwick family's material history precedes extinction. Its proposed position in the older modern reach before Nell accommodates an exceptional family-held working without a public magical profession. The grandfather, Eli and Rose have their own generational sequence; Eli's many later years and Rose's nine-day rewind are retained locally. The grandfather, Eli and his niece Rose hold the watch in turn. Repeated attempts on one April 22 leave one retained death, followed by many years of Eli’s life. Mae remembers all thirty-one lived deaths only in her continuing afterlife.

eras.title: The Counted Road
eras.description: An inherited threshold custom → The night the road becomes visible again.
context: Courier dispatch, phones, road crews and redevelopment remain in ordinary use when a generations-old household custom fails. Elsidra's fresh paint and the family's replies make a route through that local disruption. This working civic setting supports a proposed overlap with Briar Hill's courier and municipal bus life, before Nell's selected home era. The spike's origin, any common town and the two incidents' mutual order remain unknown.

A condenser's acoustic error becomes one supervised cooling trial with water, energy and access limits. Conditional acceptance is not general deployment, and the ending tests possible opt-in signals with the pump off. Its workshop context does not require an earlier global collapse.

kite-letters-below.note: The station teaches that the last ground habitats failed 812 years earlier, but its present picture of an empty surface is contradicted by living tenders. Their script resembles old service forms, establishing related provenance without a proven route of inheritance. This is a proposed Long Dark encounter between differently informed contemporaries. It neither verifies nor disproves every part of the alleged ancient failure.

apes-in-orbit.note: A surface polity with hatcheries, trams, waterworks and technical observers lives beneath human stations using an old empty-basin target. Their coexistence supplies this proposed material-era position; neither body type dates a civilization's origin. An echo and a later steering command precede one diversion, but the humans' intentions, the map's age and any relationship to the other station stories remain unknown.

the-shadow-that-nested.note: An ancient unregistered sunshade lies above working surface grids, thermal storage and a capable orbital tug crew. Reports of an omen close charging yards even while engineers coordinate a mechanical intervention. Organisms use the inherited machinery, but their full lifecycle and its builders remain unknown. The selected Long Dark horizon may overlap the stellar-road rupture; neither the shade nor its migration is identified with that network. This repair leaves a functioning surrounding society and a still-broken inhabited structure.

the-star-that-followed-the-bells.note: Ruskala's shepherds already use radios, weather instruments, bells and skilled flock handling when a wounded living vessel arrives. Its selected Long Dark frame treats the displayed fields and communications as material capabilities; the craft's age and wider origin remain unestablished. The crisis repairs local coordination, not the lost stellar route. Its broad possible horizon can fall on either side of the stellar-road rupture without identifying that event as the cause of its damage.

the-first-people.note: An ordinary-looking Earth home remains part of a civilian listening and response system with records of humanity's vastly older stellar roads. The census and Earth records align that inheritance with life predating the younger worlds. Burning the fast lattice changes interstellar access; inhabited worlds, local conflicts and slower craft remain. This is a specific transport rupture, not the extinction of magic or all technical capacity.

the-sky-remembers-us-return.note: Ordinary light from the extinction reaches an unaffected external realm after ages of perfect material zero. Dalo and Keshen originate the first new reciprocal link; its visible example is followed by distinct living exchanges across both realities. The awakening continues through dawn with varied effects, costs and refusals. The old roots and Ithrom remain dead; the first link still requires both sides to change it.

there-goes-your-name.note: Sedge's household already combines living name-calls with whistles, tracks, a trained dog, rope work and flock records. The theft interrupts one aid to direction while the other skills and relationships remain available. Canon permits either magic-active side of the Long Dark; the chosen renewed-era placement concerns this established livelihood, not the beginning of name-work. The old binding remains stolen after the new call succeeds.

the-hollow-cask.note: Successive rebuilding, coerced living labor and neglect precede Agnes's purchase. She begins with a twelve-week harvest aim and reopens a smaller independently supported hall by the gathering. This local restoration belongs within the proposed later civic craft societies; neither the earlier decline nor the colony's history is tied to the Salt Crucible or another story's catastrophe.

where-no-unicorn-stands.note: An orchard-and-channel kingdom and a mobile cloud city already inhabit different parts of one water system. A newly crowned queen's storm claim disrupts their existing lives. The chosen renewed-magical placement keeps this a local conflict between mature polities; it establishes no universal origin for their powers. Failed messages, an unauthorized abduction, an unconditional release and three bounded acts of aid have different causes and consequences. Movement and rain resume before any peace is negotiated.

a-throne-neither-wanted.note: A royal household's three-century forecast archive coexists with medical study, coastal hydrography and plans for new beacons. Its present succession turns on a fatal injury the coronation working has delayed but cannot heal. The selected old-magical placement accommodates those established professions and that specific working; the source also leaves a renewed-magic setting possible. Neither the throne nor the forecast ties this family to the neighboring divine governments.

the-kingdom-was-the-easy-part.note: Proposed in the later new-magical history as a separate kingdom after an established campaign. The old campaign hands have six years with Dabria behind them; the story does not date the entire war. The opening is six weeks after victory, and the main change concerns how former companions live afterward. A later heroic kingdom can coexist with technical cities. No old dragon lineage or connection to the Salt Crucible is established.

friends-of-the-night.note: Shalegate's siege follows an older keeper's defensive drives and six years of changed lighting, slaughter routes and tolerated nearness under Tavik. The fortified barley valley and invading host both have functioning supply and command systems. Their proposed older placement retains this local history; canon leaves the event's position before extinction or after reawakening unresolved. It has no established common war or creature system with the other frontier stories.

a-darkness-written-under-skin.note: An established dye household, clinic, registry and coach route shape this private discovery. A paid graft offers narrower color control after months of possible acceptance; it is withheld when previously unseen channels make the planned procedure unsafe. The society's birth-mark expectations do not establish a universal institution or a shared inheritance rule with other bodily powers. This later active-magical placement is proposed; an earlier active era remains possible.

anatomy-of-a-god.note: A traveler's twelve years of practical care make regeneration familiar where they come from. In a neglected mountain sanctuary, one man presents his own renewal as divinity, yet worn braces, salt jars and mineral water preserve evidence of earlier practical care there too. The encounter belongs to a proposed later inhabited region; it does not represent the invention of regenerator medicine. The site's age, divine claim and relationship to other populations remain unknown.

deaths-patron.note: A maintained district already has a ward ring, reservoir, evacuation signals, hauling crews and a working winchwright. Forty living spellwrights supply the demonstration engine's stored charge; a broken stop-pin lets it repeat through streets that continue to deteriorate. The death god needs a local willing patron and completed failures on which to act. This proposed later active era does not date his origin, establish a universal patronage rule or make the engine a return of extinct magic.

the-players-above.note: A working mill, courier routes, orchards and market catchments surround a kiln dismantled years earlier. The kiln's old cart course and silted spillway become usable through local knowledge and physical clearing. This renewed-magic placement concerns the town and one finite charged hazard; the voices' claimed cosmic game supplies no reliable location, calendar or world history. Their limited information requires correction by people who can inspect the ground.

what-the-town-owed-her.note: A modern town’s flood works and property services surround a witch whose rescue photograph is 114 years old. Open promises keep Evadne within the settlement; descendants inherit expectations rather than magical bonds. Her long life connects earlier communal aid to present-day choices.

the-inheritance-remembers.note: Courier dispatch, phones, road crews and redevelopment remain in ordinary use when a generations-old household custom fails. Elsidra's fresh paint and the family's replies make a route through that local disruption. This working civic setting supports a proposed overlap with Briar Hill's courier and municipal bus life, before Nell's selected home era. The spike's origin, any common town and the two incidents' mutual order remain unknown.

the-last-bus-to-briar-hill.note: An ordinary courier economy, municipal transit staff, contactless fares and night care work sustain the city around Maude's exceptional crossing. That continuing civic life supports a proposed overlap with The Counted Road before Nell's selected home era. Maude and the Briar Host actively tend this route; neither their history nor their powers are identified with the other story's inherited threshold custom.

the-cat-who-had-enough.note: Ten months after inheriting Mizzle, the owner works within an existing economy of freelance design, leases, advice services, bank transfers and small businesses. Mizzle's compelled replies provide limited household knowledge alongside those institutions. The selected renewed-magical era accommodates this ordinary professional life without making the cat a cause of its economy. The owner finally withdraws from a six-week bakery plan, but the sister's arranged transfer and later repayments remain separate future steps.

the-trouble-with-tuesdays.note: The Fenwick family's material history precedes extinction. Its proposed position in the older modern reach before Nell accommodates an exceptional family-held working without a public magical profession. The grandfather, Eli and Rose have their own generational sequence; Eli's many later years and Rose's nine-day rewind are retained locally. The watch is neither a common transport network nor proof that other stories share its overwritten intervals.

gods-afraid-of-grandma.note: At sixty-two, Valka enters a card game over old divine debts, interrupted when paramedics restart her heart. For forty-six years the gods divert bounded services to postpone her return and collection. At 108, the claim remains hers and the game resumes. Their domains, costs and ordinary medical limits do not establish a worldwide pantheon or immortality.

the-night-she-knew.note: Placed provisionally in the mature post-return world, this private family history does not establish an early stage of public understanding. The mother's fears of diagnosis, testing and disbelief are fears, not a documented medical response. Such secrecy could coexist with recognized powers elsewhere. An earlier active-magical age remains possible; the daughter supplies no cross-story date.

self-reflection.note: This incident belongs before extinction; its selected position near the older low-magic modern reach remains proposed. One unexplained four-dawn event occurs within school, hospital and family routines. Unlike a taught ability or licensed service, it cannot be reproduced by its witnesses. The placement does not explain its cause, date a global decline or decide Anin's fate.

thirteen-years-borrowed.note: Tamaris's living host relay spans thirteen years in a coastal society with trams, medical records and volunteer handovers. During those same years, Nivra learns to move, speak, write and work in the body Tamaris lost. The proposed later placement contains both histories; the final visit does not restore Tamaris's former life or end her need for hosts.

the-wrong-side-of-the-part.note: Proposed in the generations before Nell's low-magic home, where a privately kept implement can survive within ordinary business and family life. The wig's maker is unknown; the story establishes no family magical craft lineage. Its nonliving focus narrows Tilda's attention without replacing her judgment. This local survival does not prove that every earlier institution has vanished.

roads-under-impossible-stars.note: An established friendship and three months of strain precede one road trip before Keely's move. County maps, a failing car and unreliable phone service form its ordinary departure setting. The proposed post-return position belongs to that home frame; changing roads, the abandoned building and layered skies have no established dates or places elsewhere in the worldline. Unfamiliarity with the anomaly does not date an entire society's knowledge of powers.

by-tooth-and-threshold.note: A rural workshop, radio tracker, emergency dispatcher and police response belong to a functioning modern region. Audra's injury and the transmitter's four days of broadcasts precede her visit; her voluntary wolf change does not establish a kin group, pack history or population origin. The proposed post-return placement remains a regional history with uneven personal knowledge, not an early stage in the public discovery of all powers.

the-bat-at-the-door.note: A wildlife carer and a neighboring family use phones, a car, recovery equipment and planned medical follow-up while learning how to care for one injured child. The family's distinct language, changing rules and optional pledge coexist with that modern infrastructure. This post-return placement is proposed; the carer's surprise does not date the wider society or connect this kin group to any wolf population.

the-wolf-in-the-mirror.note: Three weeks of adapting a studio and a week of rehearsing cues precede a recurring lunar night. A specialist supplies the sound box; household barriers, a camera and agreed outside-help thresholds support the care. This proposed post-return setting has practical expertise without establishing a shared hero agency. Privacy within a family does not date the community's knowledge of powers.

she-literally-has-wings.note: Charity work, buses, hospitals and years of ordinary neighborly help form the surrounding society. Tomas regards several origins of wings as familiar possibilities, yet both he and Julian can misread Coralie. Public familiarity and private misunderstanding already coexist. Her active flight makes the zero unsuitable, but its proposed post-return date is not a discovered stage after hidden powers.

the-one-who-gets-tired.note: Leonor's Cusco combines ordinary work, buses and cinema with a divine household whose parents still have worshippers elsewhere. Her human needs have been part of the family for years. The proposed later old-magical position permits private divine life within an inhabited modern society; it supplies no shared calendar with other cities or proof of public disbelief.

a-place-for-the-living.note: The material-world supper precedes extinction; its selected position after the Bay's commemoration and before the Glass Sea's present remains proposed. Continuing family hospitality shows a different scale of life from those public landmarks, with no established connection to either. Zephra died seventy-three years before the supper, not at a dated founding of the custom. Invitation, rather than blood descent, governs family membership.

transitions-in-common.note: Established chronology places the school incident before extinction. Its selected place alongside the mature public-power reach remains proposed. Cody's privately practiced ability can remain unfamiliar to Hugo while other communities have public professions; private knowledge does not make this an earlier worldwide stage. A change takes about forty seconds, followed by roughly twenty minutes before another reliable change. The form has no established expiry.

realms.note: Queen Street already supports licensed witnesses, paid runners, medical records and screened clinical care around a living crossing. Established chronology places its material frame before extinction; the selected later urban period and overlap with Cira's repair trade and Luz's apartment maintenance remain proposed. Their services do not establish one city or a mutual date. Deepmarket's coordinates and any relationship to the six ended systems remain unknown. One transfusion helps Lena, and the dealer's arrival leaves the confrontation unresolved.

his-infernal-majesty-says-no.note: Nimelza's eighteenth-birthday departure connects a coercive tribute court to an engineering college in the same present. The court's ore revenue depends on vulnerable pack animals despite access to gates and communication devices; the college has examinations, scholarships, housing rules and limited emergency provision. Their different institutions are not successive civilizations. The human college receives this proposed post-return position, while the gate's ultimate geography and wider history remain unresolved.

the-warmest-person-in-the-room.note: Brightward already has specialist teaching, certification, clinics, equipment testing and routine maintenance. Established chronology places this story before the extinction; its selected later old-magical period remains proposed. These practices do not date it after Candlemere or any other school. Mirelle's living cold has no established link to the Glass Sea, Array or one of its terminal systems.

captive-couples.note: A working utility reserve serves three clinics and an assisted-living tower. Patrol software, a supervisor and a physician familiar with powers organize the response. This supports a proposed overlapping civic period with the Serrin family's public record and Brackenport's independent municipal policy: ordinary services and extraordinary responders operate under different rules. No common agency, city or mutual event order is established. The seventy-five-minute incident remains its own local interval.

the-name-i-kept.note: A two-generation family team works amid broadcasts, hearings, suit telemetry, power-informed medical advice and ordinary wage labor. Those existing institutions support a proposed overlapping civic period with Held Together and Brackenport's municipal policy. Different ways of employing, judging and excluding public heroes can coexist. The six-month bridge history belongs to this family; the wider profession's age, shared agencies and the three stories' mutual order remain unresolved.

witch-cold.note: Nuala's apartment, digital communications, existing work signals and ordinary nursing support place her illness within a functioning modern society. Her knowledge changes the care plan while her living power remains involuntary. The proposed overlap with the festival story allows different civilian experiences in the renewed-magical era without asserting a shared city. Her fever, unpredictable releases and damaged fittings remain local conditions, with no demonstrated new epidemic or change in the world's magic.

ultimate-evil-dog.note: Proposed in Cycle IV's developed material societies: Brightguard's engineered harness supplies lifting and flight, while a charged exchange device makes Maledict's crime possible. Municipal response channels, private research, body templates, veterinary care and legal administration support a technical public-defense economy. The public hero role does not itself require the new-magic era. The device's ultimate source is unestablished, so its interpretation as material technology remains a proposal rather than canon.

life-with-a-girlfriend-with-shrinking-po.note: Established chronology places the apartment incident before extinction. Its selected later mixed urban period remains proposed: bodily ability, ordinary appliances, building services and professional maintenance are all already in use. Luz's four-year partnership and practiced limits do not belong automatically with other transformation stories. Her twenty-four-minute maximum applies below half height, and safe cycles need at least six hours between them. The possible overlap with Queen Street's clinical services and Cira's repair trade implies neither a shared city or ability nor proximity to Faris's lifetime.

where-sleep-takes-you.note: Cira's former instrument-repair shop belongs to a city with calibrated standards, client-property obligations, GPS, building access staff and hired transport. Its proposed later old-magical position may overlap Queen Street's licensed services and Miles and Luz's apartment maintenance. These are compatible working economies with ordinary technical labor already in place; no shared city, employer or actual supply relationship is established. Her sleep-triggered displacement requires active magic but does not date it on either side of extinction or identify a named old root. The earlier placement is a reconstruction.

lightning-carries-one.note: Hazel has used solo crossings for six months when she first carries Tobin; eight outside years later they revisit changed streets by bus and on foot. Clinics have measured some bodily change, but her journey model remains incomplete and there is no demonstrated public hero organization. This proposed post-return history concerns a family's long aftermath, not a stage of the profession in Held Together or the origin of a common transport network.

when-the-needle-finds-you.note: A functioning city's recovery work, clinics, transport and radio audience surround a pirate broadcaster's coercion. Olt has supplied blood and concealed facts; a survivor redirects that practice toward him, while the Jester uses a ledger and changing broadcasts to shape people's choices. The eye's forecasts remain revisable. This proposed later active-magical setting establishes neither descent from older royal forecasts nor the origin or wider reach of the faculty.

what-turned-eighteen.note: Arlon's community expects varied changes at eighteen; family preparation, a cousin's work and Jaro's amended records show an established local custom. The first afternoon in nine bodies is personal adaptation within that continuing society. A mature post-return position is proposed, but the custom's age, population origin and relation to other cities remain unknown.

the-first-kingdom-was-late-on-taxes.note: The receiving society has already excavated Kettlebridge's surroundings for generations before the intact village arrives from millions of years earlier. Translation tools, mechanized excavation, media, rival heritage claims and temporary adjudication support a proposed late receiving frame. First Kingdom is the future's interpretation, not an established founding event. Neither departure's cycle nor arrival's absolute date is known.

the-upward-rain.note: Placed provisionally in the mature post-return world: an inhabited coast has harbor infrastructure, route traditions, mast records, scientific fieldwork and limited shore rescue. The expedition depends on that continuing society. Namarra's repair layers belong to its undated local past; investigating them does not make this the latest civilization. The sea's upward motion has no established origin or system, and an earlier magical age remains an alternative.

the-hoarders-house.note: A museum follows sale records into a crowded household where salvage knowledge, uncertain ownership and blocked access already matter. An eleven-year record dates the marker-containing lot, while the four objects' origins and other acquisition histories remain incomplete. Emergency containment and limited clearance follow observed local effects. The active seed's biology and connection to any older magic remain unknown; this proposed later placement does not establish survival of an extinct system.

the-first-wound.note: A tram incident brings an already long-lived client to a living memory specialist. His memories show a refuge 612 years earlier and a factory eighty-three years earlier, each already operating in its own crisis; they do not identify one civilization progressing into the present clinic. His estimated age is about twenty-five thousand years, with gaps. The selected post-return session does not date his earliest battle or establish the source of his longevity.

tenth-world-lesson.note: Established chronology places Ryo's material home frame before extinction. Its selected position immediately before Nell's home remains proposed and does not date his assignments. Both stories depart from a familiar life into histories their travelers cannot date. Nine years for Eiren and considerably more for Ryo do not determine elapsed time at home; the storm society and other destinations stay unplaced relative to the material sequence.

what-the-wind-wanted.note: A single afternoon from market discovery through the mountain passage to the winds' meeting. The old-magic placement is proposed; no exact date or relationship to another story is established.

the-spiders-hunger.note: An inn, a poucher who lends defensive spiders, hired carts and a sewing-shop investment support an established household economy. Living spiders consume workings while their pouches touch the wearer; repeated feeding can exhaust that protection. This proposed later magic-active placement establishes no common locality, ancestry or magical system with neighboring stories. The source leaves its position before extinction or after reawakening unresolved.

no-need-to-worry.note: The unnamed private lodge combines a demonstration cannon, intercom, cars, and a living flesh-changing faculty. This undated industrial society is provisionally placed before the terminal magical extinction; its technology alone establishes no historical relationship to another modern-looking society.

undisclosed.note: An independent old magic-active modernity is proposed before terminal extinction. Three years of accounting appointments and a recent hotel rescue precede the main evening. Cyril's earlier intervention in an unnamed conflict is recalled without a date. The compound rescue and office confrontation establish no shared geography, institution or power system with neighboring histories.

the-old-percentage.note: Elspeth returns to the same unnamed city after almost sixty years in prison. Her return follows Nobody Spends Her Name within a later technological modernity; its local interval does not establish an absolute year or date the surrounding stories.

i-really-need-a-sidekick.note: An unnamed technological society supports an independent robot performer, skilled mechanical repair and a theatrical contest culture. This wholly nonmagical setting is provisionally placed within the Long Dark, in a broad material-era horizon that may overlap other developed societies. No common city, institution, manufacturer or order of invention is established; the interval represents uncertain placement rather than the duration of the contest.

pool-sovereign.note: Undated private transformation within a contemporary-looking public-pool society. Nineteen years of queenship precede seven years of concealment; recognition and the memorial occupy about a week. The old magic-active placement is editorial and supplies no shared polity or chronology with neighboring stories.

the-ring-between-lives.note: Proposed older magic-active placement from immortal sovereignty, reincarnation, and bounded narrative awareness. The scene is undated; the ring's three centuries establish only its internal history.

the-house-beneath-the-horns.note: From a centennial handover through the following dawn. Osmund's thirteen years of hiding precede the witnessed pursuit. The proposed older-history position supplies no exact date or relation to neighboring stories.

the-cat-who-kept-the-door.note: One night begins with the three moons aligning and ends with Isabet carrying Murrant back into the palace. His nine lives and Aphan's earlier civilizational history precede the witnessed encounter; their lengths and external chronology remain unspecified.

yavrens-return.note: The witnessed return begins nine years after Yavren's supplied departure history and follows one year of restoration. Placement near When the Eagle Bowed marks the related characters and bookend reading; their differing earlier endings establish no shared factual sequence.

the-place-we-keep.note: Undated family transformations and childhood recollections precede one annual eclipse reunion. The mother stayed in the old house for eight years after the narrator left; Ibby is four months old at the present gathering. The old magic-active ordering is editorial and implies no common polity, mechanism or calendar with nearby stories.

a-seat-for-the-sun.note: An undated birthday afternoon with living solar magic. The selected pre-extinction position is provisional publication chronology; the source establishes no relative date or link to another divine figure.

a-knock-in-someone-elses-sleep: An enclosed living being harms adult quarry workers through overwhelming contact, then gradually learns a smaller approach to sleeping children.
Garnet's visits begin at seven and end at thirteen when direct contact can no longer continue safely.
Sixty years later, Cleo, nine, can remake a message for her known sleeping neighbor; she is not Garnet's descendant.
The being learns to answer Cleo's own play as well as its old friendship. A reply reaches Garnet without renewed direct adult contact.
The being remains physically enclosed. Cleo's approaching departure leaves later contact uncertain.
the-lights-beyond: Five hundred years after the horde's defeat, human law still closes the northern pass. Glaciers, broken bridges and an old road reinforce that barrier; the story does not establish the human population's contacts in every other direction.

Haskett and Dunley have scouted the southern slopes together for eleven years and saved toward an inn. An anniversary commission, approved after three councils and most of the summer, permits six days beyond the Wall.

At dusk on the second day, they discover Roskell beyond the ridges. Electric lighting, controlled traffic, shops and passenger aircraft belong to an already functioning city whose language and everyday practices they must learn through observation.

Pirvek offers a paid harbor circuit and demonstrates the aircraft's belts and safe footing. The scouts store their weapons and keep the cupboard key. Haskett chooses the flight after Dunley admits that he wants to postpone committing his share of their savings.

The flight circles the island and returns to the dock. Maintained aircraft, freight work, passengers, recreation and sleeping households reveal lives continuing independently of the scouts' discovery.
Leaving at sunrise, the siblings measure the return road and mark fords and a way around the scree. They reach the Wall on the fifth morning, before the commission's deadline.

They separate their savings and retain their own choices about the inn. Their report gives the captain a firsthand account of the road and flight; later visits, a reopened border and changes to public teaching are not shown.
where-the-white-elk-went: For at least three thousand autumns, Avarra and Winterbough follow Elderweald's circuit. Its living rhythm reaches her through roots and the elk; the unchanged boundary stones shape her expectation of where that connection ends.

Beyond the stones, halls become farm walls, orchards grow wild, old trees divert later roads and woodland occupies abandoned ground. These successive land uses precede the journey; no single catastrophe explains all the ruins.

On the first day, Winterbough crosses the old boundary and offers Avarra the choice to dismount. She goes with him. Beyond the stones she senses a faint continuation of the rhythm, including through roots at their overnight resting place.

On the second day, they cross a rootless paved court where the felt rhythm stops, then returns at the far roots. Avarra continues beside the elk through uncertainty rather than receiving an explanation of his intentions.

At noon on the third day, they find roots meeting through a recently broken buried foundation. The older and younger woodlands have already joined since the last circuit; a storm, a root's growth or their combination may have completed the connection.

Avarra leaves the old markers behind and walks with Winterbough into the younger woodland. Their relationship to the boundary changes after the landscape has changed; they do not create the new connection by discovering it.
the-morning-her-hand-moved: For a thousand years, ledgers describe settled life on a body whose death supposedly predates the towns.
Engineered cisterns, roads and registers support 5,281 residents of the inhabited hand.
The hand moves; old bracing fails and every resident is accounted for beyond the wrist.
Four counterweights close the ruined bridge; later slowing has several possible explanations.
Forearm gardens become a new settlement with revised routes, water rations and ongoing measurements.
a-crown-for-the-endless-fire: A working mine opens onto older chiseled passages and a bridge whose usual relief shutter has jammed after a tremor.
Uldek's first attempt closes the wrong relief path and worsens the load; Lemra's observations correct his diagnosis.
The return rope becomes two slings left under the bridge while controlled shutter adjustments restore a safer draft.
Lemra removes and caps the crown after the loads settle. They close the bridge and take the known service stair.
The damaged rib and spent equipment remain recorded for later work; the fire's origin is not discovered.
when-the-eagle-bowed: The custodial Eagle Queen refuses three warlords' demand for talonmail soldiers; they execute her and become competing crowns
A century later, the colony reaches Yavren and opens memories of her own former life, including a revenge plan against all three keeps
Changed paths, current horn codes and Pelka's local knowledge matter more than the queen's obsolete map
Yavren braces the threatened eyries, chooses conquest over escape and attacks the keeps separately while Pelka helps clear civilians
Across eight days, the armor defeats the three kings; Yavren releases its Eagle shadow during the final chapel battle
Yavren accepts the valley's crown and ends the royal warrants, but the shadow begins hunting an unarmed man and resists her binding sign
tea-for-the-first-guest: The wizard recalls older imperial duties, grain fleets and freight relays without knowing their present condition. By the visitor's calendar, he calculates the foundation as about 2,012 years old, with four or five years of uncertainty; he is seven months older.

The visitor enters accidentally while seeking shelter on a wet road. His immediate world contains coaching inns, carrier carts, printing, account-book repair and uncertain paid work; he cannot answer for every empire the wizard remembers.
The wizard calls him the first guest in 387 years while acknowledging other intruders. Fresh tea and an offered washroom fail to answer the visitor's need to see an actual exit.

The wizard holds the original roadside alignment open through a living working. Lamps and the drying rail lose service and the room cools; the ordinary fire remains. The visitor touches the wet arch and puts a foot on the road, confirming that he can leave.

Seeing a carrier approach, the visitor chooses to stay for another infusion until it arrives, with the doorway kept open. Their conversation turns to ordinary repairs, food and finding work; the wizard admits that his own choices helped make the tower hard to find.

The carrier nears the bend while the visitor asks about the mismatched cups. The story ends with the conversation continuing. His departure, employment and any later return to this uncertain alignment remain unshown.
a-crown-of-quiet-hours: Twelve dragons maintain forty-seven royal identities over 218 years. Their roads, sewers, grain measures and fire protection are real; the dead Crowned Ancestors are invented, and the living ruler receives no worship.

Kharost has spent nineteen months preparing a private sleep basin. On Founding Day, assistant water auditor Istra Noll finds missing cistern water and is ordered to certify the figures; the intended centuries of fixed administration have not begun.

At dusk, a festival fire meets empty hydrants. Istra opens the diverted water route and rings the Flood Bell; revealed dragons, bucket lines and other human crews contain the fire together. By midnight it is contained, with thirty-one people treated and no deaths.
An inquiry precedes six weeks of argument over a Charter. Elected human councils take law, water, taxes, records and appointments; the royal masks and state ancestor worship are retired.

Seven months after the fire, public cooling works are complete on a separate watershed, with outside access to the gates and public accounts. The dragons enter as residents under the same law, with no private claim on the city's water.
The dragons intend a two-century sleep. That future interval has not elapsed, and maintaining the settlement remains the work of the living city.
the-peace-they-could-sleep-through: For two centuries, twelve distinct dragons rotate through one worshipped royal guise. Their collective divine government sustains roads, grain reserves, district judgments and a working clerical administration.

After two failed harvests and three imported shiploads, incompatible royal judgments promise seed protection and lenders' seizure. The existing procedure book already permits parties to file a common plea; the dragons' proposed final ruling cannot remove the shortage.

At noon, Lumen refuses a final royal answer. Revelation of the twelve dragons does not itself end worship; their refusal to compel an agreement leaves farmers and importers to bargain through the older procedure.

The ninety-day agreement protects seed and pledged land while retaining limited future debt repayment and opening inventories, import costs and margins. Each side sends its own orders; city depots reopen and terrace companies stop short of the storehouses while awaiting the full clauses.

the-attendance-ledger: Six months earlier, three anonymous magical girls enlist Night Clerk for routes, weather and practical support. Gideon later infers their identities through ordinary observation.

the-dress-they-brought-her: The western sky has gone white in a battle; cameras, traffic lights and recovery archives are damaged while prison staff work twelve-hour shifts.

stay-out-of-my-city: When Elvi is ten, recurring battles have closed schools three times that month; Warren stops a harbor confrontation and excludes armed organizations

the-small-moon-rose-first: Nell and Bash experience 617 shared days in Ravel; the Regent's local identity system and the Glass Gate have different functions and living operators.

clerics-infernal-ex: Nine years earlier Emet chooses the shelter circuit over a shared life, falsely saying the House forbade the relationship and that his hinge leaf was destroyed. He keeps it concealed while Lacrixa's matching leaf remains openly mounted.

the-friends-i-built: A solo design has been accepted the previous week. Missed guardian tasks and transport make Irix late to the announcement that advanced-workshop entries must now be collaborative, with three days before teams lock.

the-players-above: The mill has needed masonry repairs after wet winters; an older kiln has been dismantled, leaving its footing and service route above the catchment. Earlier that afternoon and evening, spoken errands have already fed metallic growth before the friends notice it after their game.

where-no-unicorn-stands: Four days after the mother's coronation, her only son is abducted at night by a Pegasus captain. At dawn he reaches the cloud city trapped in the rooted storm; its surfaces support Pegasi but cannot support his body.

the-first-kingdom-was-late-on-taxes: Kettlebridge has working trades, households and a tax reeve before the aurora. A washed-out bridge contributes to three quarters of unpaid tax; this is not an established first kingdom.

the-sky-remembers-us-return: Immediately after extinction, Faris and Seyathi reach without touching, strike the ground and die. Ordinary light carries their final visible image, without their minds or any surviving power.

The royal writ changes who authorized the raid without erasing the dragon's attacks. Daziel's coupled spear and quarry brakes have created a lethal release sequence that worsening loads force Imer to revise.

One short fire burst scorches the net and injures Hovan. Daziel abandons the killing shot, dumps the spear and helps release the wing loads; Thelrax refuses treatment and takes the cleared downslope route.

At dawn the dragon clears the ridge with an injured throat; safe onward flight is unknown. Daziel ends pursuit and keeps the writ for her mother, while the three workers disable the remaining cocked mechanism before crews return.
the-five-minute-warranty: Before the blast, Director Vick rejects Kezli's pedestal-maintenance bid. The kiln explosion then breaks the crown gear, displaces the footing and buries the stairs, leaving forty people below.

Independent checks preserve the boiler, cages, cables and brakes. Replacement manufacture remains available on a scale of days; local tests support a temporary five-minute friction drive under four specified passenger loads.
